description: WWDH Reservoir Conditions is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Onda, Kyle (deposited on HydroShare). This resource contains daily statistical summaries of reservoir storage conditions for reservoirs in the Reclamation Information Sharing Environment (RISE) network. Data is generated daily by querying the Western Water Data Hub (WWDH) API's Environmental Data Retrieval (EDR) endpoint for the rise-edr collection. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2026-01-29 and last updated 2026-09-29; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
